active_milestone: Iteration 6: 100-Attendee Reliability, Load Testing & Presenter Protection (Gates P13, P14, P15, O02, O03)

iterations_summary.summary: Fixed dynamic port binding, added /healthz probe, path canonicalization against directory traversal, and production smoke tests.
Defined Knative service spec, Cloud Build pipeline, deployment script, and verified 20-worker concurrency locally.
Created firebase.json, .firebaserc, deploy_firebase.sh, and verified edge proxy rewrites and cache headers with verify_firebase_routing.py.
Validated HMAC-SHA256 token integrity, server-side RBAC demotion, IDOR access controls, and prompt injection demo isolation.
Empirically verified all 4 retrieval strategies, truthful benchmark metrics (Vector 47.6%, BM25 57.1%, Hybrid 50.0%), Gemini offline fallback, and Neo4j resilience.
Verified 350-request 100-attendee load test with 0% errors, implemented Presenter Protection Token, verified span telemetry and graceful dependency degradation.
